run_jobset_parallel_jobs: run a group of subprocesses in parallel with configurable concurrency limits and retry logic
create_jobspec_command: create a JobSpec object to define a subprocess command with timeout, retries, and environment variables
run_job_with_retries: run a Job that automatically retries on flaky failures or timeouts with configurable retry counts
check_job_state: check the current state of a running Job and get elapsed time, return code, and output
kill_running_jobs: kill all running jobs in a Jobset and collect final results with failure counts
